57struct VAPElement {
61 std::string bss;
62 std::string ssid;
63 std::string mac;
64 bool fronthaul;
65 bool backhaul;
66 bool profile1_backhaul_sta_association_disallowed = false;
67 bool profile2_backhaul_sta_association_disallowed = false;
68 int8_t link_id = -1;
69 int8_t mld_id = -1;
70 std::string ap_mld_mac;
71 eVapType vap_type = eVapType::OTHER;
72 std::string vap_label;
73
74 bool operator==(const VAPElement &other) const
75 {
76 return (bss == other.bss && ssid == other.ssid && mac == other.mac);
77 }
78
79 bool operator!=(const VAPElement &other) const { return !(*this == other); }
80};

102inline std::ostream &operator<<(std::ostream &out, const bwl::WiFiSec &sec)
103{
104 switch (sec) {
105 case bwl::WiFiSec::Invalid:
106 out << "Invalid";
107 break;
108 case bwl::WiFiSec::None:
109 out << "None";
110 break;
111 case bwl::WiFiSec::WEP_64:
112 out << "WEP-64";
113 break;
114 case bwl::WiFiSec::WEP_128:
115 out << "WEP-128";
116 break;
117 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA_PSK:
118 out << "WPA-Personal";
119 break;
120 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA2_PSK:
121 out << "WPA2-Personal";
122 break;
123 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA_WPA2_PSK:
124 out << "WPA-WPA2-Personal";
125 break;
126 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA2_WPA3_PSK:
127 out << "WPA3-Personal-Transition";
128 break;
129 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA3_PSK:
130 out << "WPA3-Personal";
131 break;
132 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA_ENTERPRISE:
133 out << "WPA-Enterprise";
134 break;
135 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA2_ENTERPRISE:
136 out << "WPA2-Enterprise";
137 break;
138 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA_WPA2_ENTERPRISE:
139 out << "WPA-WPA2-Enterprise";
140 break;
141 case bwl::WiFiSec::OWE:
142 out << "OWE";
143 break;
144 case bwl::WiFiSec::WPA3_PCM:
145 out << "WPA3-Personal-Compatibility";
146 break;
147 }
148 return out;
149}
